## Reading the chart

Penhallow is the station line second from the bottom. I converted the chart's horizontal scale to time (15:00 at x≈176, 19:00 at x≈1500, about 5.5 px per minute) and estimated when each train first reaches the Penhallow line. The estimates use each train's sloped segments and stops, so they are approximate, especially where trains stop at intermediate stations.

## Arrivals at Penhallow after 16:50 (approximate)

| Approx. time | Train | Direction |
|---|---|---|
| ~17:01 | 3707 (RE regional) | Up from Aldermoor |
| ~17:09 | 6104 (freight) | Down, stops at Penhallow |
| ~17:12 | 1209 (IC express) | Up from Aldermoor |
| ~17:16 | 3706 (RE regional) | Down from Kingsbridge |
| ~17:20 | 1210 (IC express) | Down from Kingsbridge |
| ~17:24 | 6107 (freight) | Up from Aldermoor |
| ~17:30 | 3709 (RE regional) | Up from Aldermoor |

Trains near the 16:50 boundary, such as 1208 (about 16:49–16:50), 3704 (about 16:47) and 6102 (about 16:48), appear to arrive just before the cut-off, so I excluded them.

## Result

Counting in order after 16:50: 3707, 6104, 1209, 3706, 1210. The fifth is train 1210.

The timing of 6104 and 1210 is the least certain part of this reading, since both are close together and the stop positions are hard to read exactly.

FINAL ANSWER: 1210
